stones.source: Where the merchants of seven nations gather at every solstice and equinox
stones.contract: 7 named merchant nations (maritime & overland) arranged across harbor berths by day and around 7 market fires by night.

stones.source: At every solstice and at every equinox
stones.contract: Interactive 4-cardinal solar turning dial (Vernal Equinox, Summer Solstice, Autumnal Equinox, Winter Solstice) shifting solar declination, wind/exchange ratios, and tale rotation.

stones.source: The boat that lands there with a cargo of ginger and cotton will set sail again... with yellow-striped sails; camel caravans
stones.contract: Animated lagoon dhows rigged with yellow-striped sails and desert gate camel caravans responding to bartered cargo.

stones.source: Ginger, cotton bales, pistachios, poppy seeds, nutmeg, golden muslin
stones.contract: All 6 exact commodities weighable on a damped brass balance beam and tradable across the 7 nations with scales/harbor WebAudio.

stones.source: At night, stretched beside the fires all around the market
stones.contract: Switching from Daytime Bazaar to Night beside the Fires shutters stalls into indigo twilight and ignites 7 flickering campfires with reclining merchant silhouettes.

stones.source: At every word someone says—such as wolf, sister, hidden treasure, battle, scabies, lovers—the others tell, each, his tale
stones.contract: Speaking any of the 6 exact trigger words ('wolf', 'sister', 'hidden treasure', 'battle', 'scabies', 'lovers') prompts a 7-merchant chorus around the fires and sends ember-arcs into the traveler's memory chest.

stones.source: In the long journey that awaits you... when you set to thinking of all your memories one by one, your wolf will have become another wolf, your sister a different sister, your battle other battles
stones.contract: Irrevocable mutation of the traveler's memory pack for spoken trigger words while preserving unspoken words intact; verified on the Return Voyage via <voyage-recall-chest>.

inner_arch: You do not come to Euphemia only to buy and sell cargo, but because at night beside the market fires every spoken trigger word ('wolf', 'sister', 'hidden treasure', 'battle', 'scabies', 'lovers') prompts the seven nations' merchants to trade tales—so that on the long return voyage, summoning your own memories yields another's story in place of your own.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Tri-phase Caravanserai Brass Balance, Nocturnal Seven-Fire Story Ring & Palimpsest Return-Voyage Memory Chest with procedural WebAudio
anti_trude_vector.css_namespace: .eup-* (100% prefixed selectors, zero generic layout wrappers div/section/main/header/footer/nav/aside/article)

frozen_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: zero occurrences of http://, https://, or ../; zero console/page errors; title-masked Blind Recognition identifies Euphemia without upfront essay spoilers.
frozen_gates.HG-2: Causal participation of all Calvino stones: 7 nations, 4 solstices/equinoxes, yellow-striped sails & camel caravans, 6 daytime commodities ('ginger', 'cotton bales', 'pistachios', 'poppy seeds', 'nutmeg', 'golden muslin'), 7 night campfires, 6 canonical trigger words ('wolf', 'sister', 'hidden treasure', 'battle', 'scabies', 'lovers') irrevocably swapping the traveler's recalled memories on the return voyage while unspoken memories remain native.
frozen_gates.HG-3: Viewport & accessibility hygiene: zero horizontal/vertical occlusion at 1280x800 and 390x844; full keyboard support (B/N/V phases, T turning, 1-6 actions, P plate drawer, Z loupe, Escape, M mute, R reset) + prefers-reduced-motion; <euphemia-plate-drawer> [P] inspects map.png (fallback map.svg -> inline SVG element) and image.png (fallback inline SVG element) without fetch().
frozen_gates.HG-4: Anti-Trude DOM/CSS uniqueness (J_dom < 0.35): bespoke hyphenated custom tags only, 100% .eup-* CSS class prefixing, plus valid Royal Plate Guild III map.png (1600x1200), map.svg, and image.png (1600x1000) on disk before final SEALED.
